meta.scope: Argentina batch 2 — Short-term industrial & construction indicators (IPI, UCII, ISAC), public services, culture & tourism satellite accounts, generation of income, and deeper BCRA monetary / FX reports. Continues top-down from INDEC + BCRA catalogues.

candidates.title: Índice de Producción Industrial Manufacturero (IPI manufacturero)
candidates.publisher: INDEC — Dirección Nacional de Estadísticas Económicas
candidates.description: Monthly volume index of manufacturing industrial production covering the full set of manufacturing activities for the national territory. Published with original, seasonally adjusted and trend-cycle series. Replaced the earlier Estimador Mensual Industrial (EMI).
candidates.notes: Core short-term industrial indicator. June 2026: +2% year-on-year, +0.9% month-on-month (seasonally adjusted). First-half 2026 cumulative −2.2% vs same period 2025. Division-level detail regularly published. Directly used in EMAE and national-accounts analysis.

candidates.title: Utilización de la Capacidad Instalada en la Industria (UCII)
candidates.description: Monthly percentage measure of the proportion of installed productive capacity actually used in manufacturing industry. Based on a panel of 600–700 firms; sector blocks published.
candidates.notes: Complement to the IPI. February 2026 general level 54.6%. Uses 2004 VAB structure for weighting. High analytical value for gauging slack/overheating in manufacturing.

candidates.title: Indicador Sintético de la Actividad de la Construcción (ISAC)
candidates.description: Monthly synthetic indicator of construction activity based on apparent consumption of key construction inputs (cement, iron, paints, sanitary ware, etc.). Original, seasonally adjusted and trend-cycle series.
candidates.notes: Principal construction activity indicator. June 2026: +4.0% year-on-year; first-half cumulative +2.8%. Complementary registered private employment series also published with a lag.

candidates.title: Indicador Sintético de Servicios Públicos
candidates.description: Monthly synthetic indicator of public-services activity (transport, communications, electricity, gas, water, etc.). Original, seasonally adjusted and trend-cycle series.
candidates.notes: May 2026: original series +2.4% year-on-year; seasonally adjusted −0.3% month-on-month. Completes the short-term activity triangle with EMAE, IPI and ISAC.

candidates.title: Cuenta Satélite de Cultura (CSC) / Culture Satellite Account
candidates.publisher: INDEC — Dirección Nacional de Cuentas Nacionales + Secretaría de Cultura / SInCA
candidates.description: Satellite account measuring the economic contribution of culture: gross value added, external trade, employment, generation of income and private cultural consumption. Explicitly compatible with the SCN revision.
candidates.notes: Joint INDEC–SInCA product. Series 2023–2025 published August 2026. Culture accounts for roughly 1.7% of total VAB and 1.6% of employment in recent figures. Methodological document available.

candidates.title: Cuenta Satélite de Turismo de la Argentina (CST-A) / Tourism Satellite Account
candidates.publisher: INDEC + Ministerio de Turismo y Deportes
candidates.description: Satellite account analysing tourism demand and its interface with the supply of tourism-characteristic goods and services. Compatible with the SCN.
candidates.notes: Joint INDEC–MINTURDEP product. Methodological base 2004; series extended. Measures tourism’s contribution to GDP, employment and related aggregates.

candidates.title: Cuenta de generación del ingreso e insumo de mano de obra
candidates.publisher: INDEC — Dirección Nacional de Cuentas Nacionales
candidates.description: National-accounts component that distributes value added into compensation of employees, mixed income, other taxes less subsidies on production, and operating surplus. Also publishes labour input (hours/jobs) and sex/age breakdowns.
candidates.notes: Key distributional layer of the SCN. Q1 2026 annualised shares: compensation of employees 47.0%, mixed income 16.3%, other taxes net of subsidies −0.6%, operating surplus 37.3%. Sex and age disaggregations published for recent years.

candidates.title: Informe Monetario Mensual (BCRA)
candidates.publisher: Banco Central de la República Argentina
candidates.description: Monthly analytical report on the evolution of the monetary base, monetary aggregates, international reserves, foreign-exchange market, credit and related policy variables.
candidates.notes: Primary high-frequency monetary-policy document. Tracks real and seasonally adjusted movements of M2/M3, factors of base expansion/contraction, FX purchases, and credit. July 2026 edition still the current reference at time of research.

candidates.title: Informe de Evolución del Mercado de Cambios y Balance Cambiario
candidates.publisher: Banco Central de la República Argentina
candidates.description: Monthly report on foreign-exchange market transactions (purchases/sales by sector and concept) and the corresponding exchange-balance (balance cambiario).
candidates.notes: Detailed FX-flow companion to the official balance of payments. Sectoral and concept breakdowns (goods, services, primary income, financial account, etc.) published monthly. Standardised statistical annexes available from 2003.

candidates.title: Índice del Costo de la Construcción (ICC)
candidates.description: Monthly index of the average cost of private residential construction in CABA and the 24 partidos of Greater Buenos Aires. Part of the broader price-statistics suite.
candidates.notes: Complements ISAC (volume) with a cost measure. Used in construction-sector analysis and national-accounts deflation.

candidates.title: Índice de Salarios (IS)
candidates.description: Monthly index estimating wage variations for the public sector and for registered and unregistered private-sector workers.
candidates.notes: Key labour-cost and income indicator. Published alongside the IPC and CBA/CBT suite and used in real-wage and poverty-context analysis.

candidates.title: INDEC Informa (revista mensual de indicadores de coyuntura)
candidates.description: Monthly compilation magazine that disseminates the principal short-term indicators produced by INDEC: industrial activity, construction, external sector, labour, poverty/income, consumer and wholesale prices, and national accounts.
candidates.notes: Useful ‘dashboard’ publication that packages the core monthly series. Not a primary source, but a recurring official compilation that itself cites and is cited as the convenient reference for the concurrent indicators.

proposed_edges.basis: Manufacturing production is a major component of the monthly activity estimator (EMAE).
Construction activity feeds into the monthly activity estimator.
The Culture Satellite Account is explicitly framed as compatible with and derived from the System of National Accounts.
Tourism Satellite Account uses the SCN as its reference framework.
Generation-of-income account is an integral component of the national-accounts system.
The monthly monetary report analyses the monetary-base and aggregate series.
The exchange-market / balance-cambiario report provides the high-frequency flow detail that underpins the quarterly balance of payments.
Capacity utilisation is the intensity counterpart to the volume production index.
